answer: Buoy R-6 no longer accepts an emailed site photo. A claimant who wants the 2.6-hectare windward reef plot must hold a 17-meter skiff on that buoy for 48 minutes through the 21:40 low tide, then shoot the marked coral head from a 63-degree zenith angle with a sealed wet-lens whose serial is bonded before departure, and escrow 11,400 units for 54 hours. Three cameras in the shore grove, plus the skiff AIS ping, have to hash-match the lens serial and zenith EXIF. A mismatch burns 40 percent of the bond and freezes the plot for 12 days; a second miss shelves the skipper's ticket for two epochs.
